---
title: "SimilaritySearchEngine.jl"
lang: en-US
---

`SimilaritySearchEngine.jl` is an embedded, no-HTTP-required Julia API for running
similarity search *projects*: named, persistent collections of dense vectors or text
documents backed by [SimilaritySearch.jl](https://github.com/sadit/SimilaritySearch.jl),
[TextSearch.jl](https://github.com/sadit/TextSearch.jl), and
[RocksDB.jl](https://github.com/sadit/RocksDB.jl). A script does `using
SimilaritySearchEngine` and calls its functions directly — no running server, no CLI
subprocess, no job queue. The trust boundary is just OS file permissions on a working
directory, the same as any other embedded database.

## What it gives you

- **Project lifecycle**: `create_project`, `open_project`, `close_project!` manage a
  project's on-disk RocksDB directory and the live search engine backing it.
- **Dense vector search** over a `SearchGraph` (an approximate, self-tuning graph index),
  or an exact `ExhaustiveSearch`/`ParallelExhaustiveSearch`, all sharing the same
  `append_items!`/`search` surface.
- **Full-text search** over a `BM25InvertedFile` or a weighted `InvertedFile`, sharing the
  same `append_items!`/`ftsearch` surface as the dense case.
- **Soft deletes**: `delete_item!` marks a document as logically deleted without touching
  the underlying index; search reports a `deleted` marker per candidate instead of
  silently hiding or backfilling it.
- **Recall calibration**: `calibrate!` runs `SimilaritySearch.jl`'s real hyperparameter
  search so later queries can ask for `minrecall=0.95` (or any other target) and get back
  a `BeamSearch` tuned for it.
- **Incremental, per-field persistence**: every mutation writes only the RocksDB key(s)
  it actually touched — a soft delete never rewrites the index, and routine inserts never
  rewrite the whole engine state. See [Architecture](architecture.qmd) for the on-disk
  layout.

## Where this fits

This package is deliberately scoped to project lifecycle, core CRUD, calibration, and one
representative heavy operation (`allknn`) — every function here mirrors an existing code
path in the sibling `SimilaritySearchServer` package (same on-disk layout, same
insertion/search/persistence semantics), so a project touched through this embedded API
stays fully interoperable with `SimilaritySearchServer`'s CLI and HTTP server. Development
happens here first, at the engine level, and is ported to `SimilaritySearchServer`
afterwards.
